rule: disabledDate restricts endpoints. Interior disabled dates/months/years may be spanned and remain gray; no interior interval scan or truncation introduced.
changes: Maple disabled interior band now uses the same gray fill as Cedar for both selected and preview ranges.
Paging clears transient hover preview while preserving the clicked first endpoint.
Cedar forwards a complete renderer candidate when it equals the existing range, restoring confirmation after restarting the same range.
Cedar year page controls use period accessibility labels.
Form demo includes synthetic cross-year date/month ranges and a cross-century year range; docs clarify endpoint-only disabled rules.

checks.sameSource: 43 pairs and field/panel presentation boundaries passed

validationNotes: Final regressions use isolated workers with concurrency limited to one; a diagnostic run without worker isolation shared the Vue SSR document cache and is not used as validation.
